name: gsc-mcp-lite
description: Read-only Google Search Console Performance data: clicks, impressions, CTR and position by query, page, country, device and date.
long_description: Two read-only tools over the Search Console API, nothing else: list-properties and search-analytics (the Performance report: clicks, impressions, CTR and position by query, page, country, device, date, search appearance or hour, with filters, search type and paging). Bring a credentials file from your own Google Cloud project: a service-account key or a Desktop-app OAuth client. The README explains how to get one.

tools.name: list-properties
tools.description: The Search Console properties the credentials can see, with permission levels.

tools.name: search-analytics
tools.description: The Performance report: clicks, impressions, CTR and position by query, page, country, device, date or search appearance, with filters and paging.

credentials.title: Google credentials file
credentials.description: The JSON file from Google Cloud: a service-account key or a Desktop-app OAuth client. See the README for the steps.
